faq.title: Discount and promotion questions
faq.tabsAriaLabel: Frequently asked questions about special offers

faqItems.question: How do weekly discounts work?
faqItems.answer: Each restaurant features three dishes with 15%, 20% and 40% discounts. Browse active offers on this page and order while they last.

faqItems.question: Are offers available every day?
faqItems.answer: Offers rotate by day and depend on restaurant availability. The weekly schedule shows the offers planned for each day.

faqItems.question: Does the invite code expire?
faqItems.answer: The expiry date and usage terms will be clearly shown with your personalised code when the referral programme launches.

faqItems.question: Can I combine multiple discounts?
faqItems.answer: One promo code or one special offer normally applies per order, unless the offer specifically states otherwise.

faqItems.question: Where are special offers available?
faqItems.answer: donesi.me special offers are currently available for addresses within the Podgorica delivery area.
